jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide dates binding on participating firms)
jobs.notes: Official scheme page lists 2027 dates as applications opening Wednesday 9 June at 9:00am AEST with two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July, 11:59pm AEST) depending on the firm, and offers from Wednesday 8 September — so a single scheme-wide close date cannot be confirmed; eligibility is generally penultimate-year students, and the 2026 cycle has already closed.

jobs.employer: Queensland Law Society (scheme-wide guidelines for participating firms)
jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment (next cycle)
jobs.notes: The official QLS page confirms the recruitment cycle commences with clerkship applications in July/August with Summer One, Summer Two, Autumn and Winter programs and priority graduate decisions in early August, but no specific calendar dates for the next cycle are published on the page, so opens/closes are left null rather than guessed.
